toefl:se:527.answer: I especially loved the homemade pizza—it was delicious—and the fun games you organized.
toefl:se:527.fullSentence: I especially loved the homemade pizza—it was delicious—and the fun games you organized.
toefl:se:527.japanese: 特に手作りのピザ(とてもおいしかったです)と、あなたが企画してくれた楽しいゲームが気に入りました。
toefl:se:527.explanation: organize ~ で「〜を企画する、準備する」という意味。
toefl:se:527.relatedInfo: the games you planned / the games you set up

toefl:se:528.answer: Playing those games made the evening so lively and cheerful for me.
toefl:se:528.fullSentence: Playing those games made the evening so lively and cheerful for me.
keyPhrases: made the evening so lively and cheerful
toefl:se:528.japanese: あのゲームで遊んだことで、私にとってその夜はとても賑やかで楽しいものになりました。
toefl:se:528.explanation: make + O + 形容詞 で「〜を…にする」という使役的な構造。
toefl:se:528.relatedInfo: made the night so much fun / brought so much energy to the evening

toefl:se:529.answer: The whole party made me feel bright and happy, and I had a wonderful time.
toefl:se:529.fullSentence: The whole party made me feel bright and happy, and I had a wonderful time.
keyPhrases: made me feel bright and happy
toefl:se:529.japanese: パーティー全体が私を明るく幸せな気持ちにしてくれて、素晴らしい時間を過ごしました。
toefl:se:529.explanation: make me feel ~ で「私を〜な気持ちにさせる」という表現。
toefl:se:529.relatedInfo: made me feel so happy / I had such a great time

toefl:se:530.answer: It meant a lot to celebrate with you and everyone else.
toefl:se:530.fullSentence: It meant a lot to celebrate with you and everyone else.
keyPhrases: meant a lot to celebrate with you
toefl:se:530.japanese: あなたやほかのみんなと一緒にお祝いできたことは、とても意味のあることでした。
toefl:se:530.explanation: mean a lot to 人 で「〜にとって大きな意味がある」という表現。
toefl:se:530.relatedInfo: it was really special to celebrate with / it meant so much

toefl:se:531.answer: I hope we can get together again soon for another fun day!
toefl:se:531.fullSentence: I hope we can get together again soon for another fun day!
toefl:se:531.japanese: また近いうちに集まって、もう一度楽しい一日を過ごせたらいいなと思っています!
toefl:se:531.explanation: get together で「集まる、会う」というカジュアルな表現。
toefl:se:531.relatedInfo: hang out again soon / meet up again

toefl:se:532.answer: I look forward to hearing from you.
toefl:se:532.fullSentence: I look forward to hearing from you.
toefl:se:532.japanese: お返事をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:532.explanation: look forward to hearing from you はメール結びの定番表現。
toefl:se:532.relatedInfo: I look forward to your reply.

toefl:se:533.explanation: Kind regards,はメールの結びに使う丁寧な定型表現。

toefl:se:534.explanation: 教師への丁寧な書き出し。
toefl:se:534.relatedInfo: Dear Professor Harris, / Dear Mr. Harris:

toefl:se:535.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:535.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:535.japanese: お元気でお過ごしのことと思います。
toefl:se:535.explanation: ビジネス・フォーマルメールの定番の書き出し。
toefl:se:535.relatedInfo: I hope you are doing well.

toefl:se:536.answer: I am writing to explain my absence from your recent biology class.
toefl:se:536.fullSentence: I am writing to explain my absence from your recent biology class.
toefl:se:536.japanese: 先日の生物の授業を欠席したことについて説明するためにご連絡しています。
toefl:se:536.explanation: explain my absence from ~ で「〜の欠席について説明する」という意味。
toefl:se:536.relatedInfo: writing to let you know why I missed / explain why I was absent from

toefl:se:537.answer: Unfortunately, I was suddenly ill and could not attend.
toefl:se:537.fullSentence: Unfortunately, I was suddenly ill and could not attend.
toefl:se:537.japanese: 残念ながら、急に体調を崩してしまい出席できませんでした。
toefl:se:537.explanation: suddenly ill で「急に体調を崩した」という意味。
toefl:se:537.relatedInfo: fell suddenly sick / came down with an illness

toefl:se:538.answer: I am worried that I missed some important homework and lessons during that session.
toefl:se:538.fullSentence: I am worried that I missed some important homework and lessons during that session.
toefl:se:538.japanese: その授業で大事な宿題や内容を見逃してしまったのではないかと心配しています。
toefl:se:538.explanation: during that session で「その授業の間に」という時間を表す前置詞句。
toefl:se:538.relatedInfo: during that class / in that lesson

toefl:se:539.answer: Could you please let me know what assignments I missed and how I can catch up?
toefl:se:539.fullSentence: Could you please let me know what assignments I missed and how I can catch up?
keyPhrases: let me know what assignments i missed
toefl:se:539.japanese: どの課題を見逃したのか、そしてどうすれば追いつけるのか教えていただけますか?
toefl:se:539.explanation: catch up で「遅れを取り戻す」という意味の句動詞。
toefl:se:539.relatedInfo: how I can make up for it / how I can get caught up

toefl:se:540.answer: Also, I would appreciate your instructions on how to submit any work that is already past the deadline.
toefl:se:540.fullSentence: Also, I would appreciate your instructions on how to submit any work that is already past the deadline.
toefl:se:540.japanese: また、締め切りをすでに過ぎている課題をどのように提出すればよいか、ご指示いただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:540.explanation: past the deadline で「締め切りを過ぎた」という意味。

toefl:se:541.answer: Thank you very much for your understanding.
toefl:se:541.fullSentence: Thank you very much for your understanding.
toefl:se:541.japanese: ご理解いただき誠にありがとうございます。
toefl:se:541.explanation: thank you for your understanding は事情説明の後に添える定番表現。

toefl:se:542.answer: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:542.fullSentence: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:542.japanese: お返事をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:542.explanation: メール結びの定型表現。
toefl:se:542.relatedInfo: I look forward to hearing from you.

toefl:se:543.explanation: メールの結びに使う丁寧な定型表現。

src: ヘッドホンの故障1・ヘッドホンの故障2

toefl:se:545.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:545.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:545.japanese: お元気でお過ごしのことと思います。
toefl:se:545.explanation: ビジネスメールの定番の書き出し。
toefl:se:545.relatedInfo: I hope you are doing well.

toefl:se:546.answer: I am writing regarding an issue with the headphones I bought from your store last weekend.
toefl:se:546.fullSentence: I am writing regarding an issue with the headphones I bought from your store last weekend.
keyPhrases: bought from your store last weekend
toefl:se:546.japanese: 先週末に貴店で購入したヘッドホンの不具合についてご連絡しています。
toefl:se:546.explanation: regarding ~ は「〜に関して」という意味のフォーマルな前置詞。
toefl:se:546.relatedInfo: writing about a problem with / writing concerning an issue with

toefl:se:547.answer: After using them for a few days, I noticed that the sound often cuts out on one side.
toefl:se:547.fullSentence: After using them for a few days, I noticed that the sound often cuts out on one side.
keyPhrases: after using them for a few days
sound often cuts out on one side
toefl:se:547.japanese: 数日間使用した後、片方から音がよく途切れることに気づきました。
toefl:se:547.explanation: cut out で「(音などが)途切れる、止まる」という意味の句動詞。
toefl:se:547.relatedInfo: the sound keeps dropping out / the audio cuts off

toefl:se:548.answer: This problem makes it difficult to enjoy music or listen to recordings, as I cannot hear clearly from both sides.
toefl:se:548.fullSentence: This problem makes it difficult to enjoy music or listen to recordings, as I cannot hear clearly from both sides.
keyPhrases: makes it difficult to enjoy music
cannot hear clearly from both sides
toefl:se:548.japanese: 両側からはっきり聞こえないため、この問題のせいで音楽を楽しんだり録音を聞いたりするのが難しくなっています。
toefl:se:548.explanation: make it difficult to ~ で「〜することを難しくする」という形式目的語構文。
toefl:se:548.relatedInfo: makes it hard to / prevents me from enjoying

toefl:se:549.answer: I would appreciate it if you could advise me on repair or replacement options for these headphones.
toefl:se:549.fullSentence: I would appreciate it if you could advise me on repair or replacement options for these headphones.
keyPhrases: would appreciate it if you could advise me
toefl:se:549.japanese: このヘッドホンの修理または交換の選択肢についてアドバイスいただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:549.explanation: I would appreciate it if you could ~ は丁寧に依頼する定型表現。
toefl:se:549.relatedInfo: I would be grateful if you could let me know / could you please advise me on
